Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: Misstated the production site of aldosterone by confusing adrenal cortex zones—incorrectly implying aldosterone (a mineralocorticoid) is produced by the zona fasciculata (glucocorticoid zone) rather than the zona glomerulosa. This reflects a factual mix-up between cortical zones and hormone classes.
